build_pipeline_coroutine: build a pipeline coroutine from a PipelineConfig with max failures and background tasks
build_pipeline_node: build a pipeline node graph from a PipelineConfig with queue and hook factory settings
run_pipeline_coroutines: run all pipeline stage coroutines with background tasks and error handling
handle_pipeline_failure: handle PipelineFailure exceptions that aggregate errors from failed pipeline stages
cancel_orphaned_tasks: cancel orphaned upstream tasks when a pipeline node completes to prevent deadlocks
